title: Unified-memory budget and the memguard kill/restart loop on two GB10 boxes
why: It shows the shared memory pool as one budget and the timed guard sequence that turns a low MemAvailable reading into a rank restart and client retry.
nodes: Shared LPDDR5X pool: 111.5 GB / 111,515,771,428 bytes covering weights, KV caches, live streams
MemAvailable read from /proc/meminfo on a timer
Kernel closes sockets; in-flight requests get connection reset
Rank reloads its shard from disk
notes: No axes; this is a dataflow/control loop. The pool is a single shared budget at 273 GB/s, not separate VRAM plus host memory. The guard reads MemAvailable on a timer and branches at the 2.5 GiB threshold; the kill path is uncatchable, so socket cleanup is done by the kernel and recovery flows through launcher restart, shard reload, and client retry. All labelled quantities come from the chapter. | Flow runs layer by layer across two ranks; each layer has two cross-rank boundaries, so L layers give 2L all-reduces per forward pass. The payload at each boundary is the batch activation matrix in bf16: decode is 16 × H × 2 bytes, prefill is 130,659 × H × 2 bytes, and prefill is 130,659/16 = 8,166 times larger. The all-reduce is issued after the local matmul and before the next layer's matmul; overlap with next-layer compute requires independent scheduler work, usually absent at decode. Label the pair stall counter as 120,000 ms cumulative, not decomposed by collective or rank. | x-axis: number of concurrent streams (1 and 4). y-axis: aggregate decode tok/s. Plot the single-stream point at 59.1, the linear extrapolation to 236.4 at 4 streams, and the measured 106.2 at 4 streams; annotate the 45% shortfall and the 1.80x multiplier. Mark the 16-row kernel width and the 2,197/3,003 MHz clock as candidate constraints, not as isolated causes. All quantities come from the section. | No axes; two parallel dataflows. Prefix-cache flow labels 12,804,579 prompt tokens looked up, 12,285,952 served from cache (95.9%), prefill rate 39,237, and 313 seconds of prefill work removed; workload context: 98 requests, mean prompt length 130,659 tokens. Speculative flow labels mtp_drafted_total = 62,390, mtp_accepted_total = 42,181, acceptance 67.6%, and notes that drafts become extra rows in the 16-row verify kernel, drawing on the same concurrency budget. | Draw the shared pool as a horizontal bar partitioned into four equal stream segments at 65,536 positions each. Inside one segment, mark the reservation block of 32,786 positions and the remaining admission ceiling of 32,750. Show a second bar for the native 1,048,576-position window split into four 262,144-position segments, with reservation 32,786 and ceiling 229,358. Label the KV bytes-per-position constant 921.6 and the extra 0.68 GiB per rank.
